cap.description: What it may release in all: the break-glass payment cap when it started.

ended_at.description: When an Owner ended it sooner; absent unless one did.

ended_by.description: The Owner who ended it sooner.

expires_at.description: When it expires: 24 hours after it started (FM-8).

overdue.description: true while it is unreviewed after its review's due date: Checks shows it as cannot post until fixed (C.2 #53), which refuses the close (FM-4).

examples: Wei Jie is on a flight until Friday; salaries are due tomorrow

releases.description: The batches it released, oldest first.

review_due_at.description: When its review is due: 7 days after it ends. Until then only another Owner reviews it; from then the Accountant may too.

started_by.description: The Owner who started it: the only one who releases under it.

status.description: active for 24 hours from its start unless an Owner ends it sooner; ended after.

version.description: Its version: send it as If-Match to end it.

you_may_end.description: true when you, an Owner, may end it now.

you_may_review.description: true when you may review it now.
